vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are in 2 groups based on colour. Group 1: red, brown, pink, purple. Group 2: orange, blue, yellow, green. The better group to choose swaps. Stick with 1 group until you notice you are getting 3 mushrooms on 1x bonus then swap to the other group.
